question: How can GA compose a bounded, testable agentic audio-improvement experiment while dogfooding the actual ComfyUI bridge and preserving independent acceptance evidence?
production_path: investigation: observe hypothesize test conclude reflect
hypothesis: A fixed baseline/reference, explicit pure transformations and effect boundaries, and an independent acceptance rule can expose false progress and make agent-driven audio iterations reviewable; a byte-identical candidate is a useful negative control.
evidence: GA local commit 6fac5735f7ffbb4116ebee05cfc9d7911bb12ce9 adds Rust/guitar-web-wasm-demo/scripts/run-comfy-audio.js, compare-audio.js, a pass-through workflow, mock tests, and documentation. It is not pushed or merged. The mock tests pass; a live ComfyUI refinement was not run.

state/streeling/fixtures/computer-science/cs-004/control-evidence.json records a rerun using identical GA-rendered E2 baseline and candidate WAVs, the recorded GAS-001 E2 reference, 1.1-second reference offset, and 1.5-second window. Both RMS errors were exactly 0.12415874627653194; all reported FFT and Haar errors also matched.
The GAS-001 fixture README identifies WAV sources, hashes, CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution for the recording, native GA render settings, and onset limits.

state/streeling/fixtures/computer-science/cs-004/positive-control-evidence.json records two deliberate FFmpeg perturbations of the pinned native render. The comparator's RMS and spectral summaries changed, showing sensitivity to those controls without establishing perceptual improvement.

state/streeling/fixtures/computer-science/cs-004/review-followup-20261004.md records a bounded wmux Claude review with verified read/write receipt. It identified a missing known-perturbation control and an underspecified listening protocol; those are now addressed in the draft as testable proposals, not validated requirements.

state/streeling/fixtures/computer-science/cs-004/recursive-improvement-evidence.json contrasts the denied and completed wmux reviews and the negative and known-perturbation audio controls. It records missing throughput and learner-outcome measures, so it does not establish compounding progress.

GA docs/methodology/agentic-engineering.md explains harness design, bounded queues, review, and quality baselines. Existing Streeling CS-002 covers governed loops, but does not walk through this audio control and composition boundary.

ComfyUI core LoadAudio/SaveAudio nodes and server upload/prompt/history/view routes are documented in source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/blob/master/comfy_extras/nodes_audio.py and https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/blob/master/server.py
